Synonyms: Iyashite Agerun Saiyuki, The Karma Saiyuki, Viaje al Oeste, Саюки, 치유해줄께서유기
Type: OVA - Aired: 2007 - Duration: 35 m.

Update of my 2018 release -  SUBTITLES (* new sub added)
**ARA** (AHMax-Sub)* - **CHI** (Maho.sub) * - **ENG** (Hen-Time – RG Genshiken)  - **FRE** (Hentai Revolution* & Kitsune) - **GER** (Xorax & PowerPuff Subs*) - **HRV** (TanukiSubs 2011)* - **IND** (Nekopoi)* - **ITA** (Kitsune & HFIF*) - **POL** (Nyan) - **POR** (H-Agaman – Lolicons Anonimos) - **RUS** (Narru) - **SPA** (AniMex – AniMugen - Kitsune) - **TUR** (Meiji-H 2011)*   -  ( **see notes inside for further information**)
**DUB**: **RUS** (single voice - Dez ) - **RUS** (dual voice - Horie & Sati Akura)
**MANGA**: ENG - SPA

Parody of a parody. The OVA is the funny, hentai parody of a Dragon Ball special, which in turn is a parody of Journey to the West.
"Journey to the West" is a Chinese historical novel in which a Buddhist monk is accompanied on the journey in search of Buddhist texts by three disciples - the monkey king Sun Wukong, the pig Zhu Wuneng and the river demon Sha Wujing, who decide to protect him from the pitfalls of the trip.
Here, however, the three disciples are three uninhibited girls who can repair broken machines thanks to the power of their pendants and the monk is a profiteer who sexually blackmails because he has discovered their secret. The OVA deserves to be watched also for the strange conglomeration of various elements ranging from comedy to action scenes with comic comedy and a not ordinary sex, well-written and drawn, which embraces the most diverse genres that, when non-traditional, are presented in a more comical and grotesque way than perverted.
